title: Kennedy Center Ceiling Partially Collapses Due to Neglect
summary: A portion of the ceiling at the Kennedy Center in Washington D.C. partially collapsed in the grand foyer. A spokesperson for the venue attributed the incident to "decades of neglect." The collapse occurred at the performing arts venue. Following the incident, the Kennedy Center renewed calls for a shutdown, referencing a "Trump-backed shutdown."
summary_points: Part of the ceiling at the Kennedy Center in Washington D.C. collapsed.
A Kennedy Center spokesperson cited "decades of neglect" as the cause.
The incident occurred in the venue's grand foyer.
The Kennedy Center renewed calls for a shutdown after the collapse.
